name: Tab Open Icon
description: Icon for opening in new tab or window with animated opening effect

variations.name: default
variations.description: On hover, the dark tab slides up, the base slides down, and the triangle arrow pops up between them creating an opening effect

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Controls the opening animation. Manage this state in the parent via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave.
